method: Front interior resampled from the original worn photograph on the fitted portrait. Other regions enlarged from the approved pink base. The delivered coral is the direct Ideogram response.

comparison.layout: Original, previous coral, new coral. Original crops centered on corresponding landmarks, sampled directly from the unwarped worn photo. Same scale across each row, with no sharpening or color adjustments.
comparison.detail_check: Pearson correlation of bandpass luma against the registered original photograph. All images on the 1664 x 2496 grid. Bandpass is a difference of Gaussians with sigmas 0.55 and 1.7 px. Samples include the reviewed front interior with alpha >= 250. This is an alignment-sensitive texture metric.
